summary: Focused retest of the 3 issues from iteration_1 plus real visual capture of the slash arc. All three previously-reported bugs (HIGH reduced-motion, MEDIUM viewport reachability, LOW hint placement) are FIXED. Slash arc is now visually confirmed via a screenshot with animation paused at 300ms. Reduced-motion works on initial load, dynamically after the page is loaded, and cancels an in-flight slash mid-animation. Star trail scene renders with data-trail='active' and canvas draws non-transparent pixels in Skills. No new runtime errors introduced (only pre-existing THREE.Clock deprecation warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: useSceneMedia in WeaponRain.tsx now correctly subscribes to matchMedia 'change' via native window.matchMedia + useState, replacing the previously flaky motion/react useReducedMotion hook. Both scenes (WeaponRain + OrbitStarScene) share it and now update dynamically without reload. Verified via emulate_media before load AND at runtime.

KatanaSlash.tsx effect cleanup correctly cancels the WAAPI shake when reducedMotion flips true mid-slash (running content animations dropped from 1 to 0 within 200ms). Portal SVG also stops rendering because parent gate short-circuits with `if (reducedMotion) return null` and CSS `.katana-slash-overlay { display:none }` provides belt-and-suspenders.

About.tsx Reveal now has `lg:self-start` so the katana column top-aligns with the intro text. At 1440x900 the projected hit target midpoint sits at y~733 (well inside 900px viewport) and at 1920x800 it sits at y~722 (inside 800px). elementFromPoint at midpoint correctly returns [data-testid=about-katana-slash-button] in both cases.

katana-hit-label now anchored at top:50% with translate(12px,44px) after counter-rotation → the hint sits horizontally beneath the blade midpoint (measured y~765 vs blade midpoint ~733) and remains fully within layout, not clipped by portrait or stat cards while the katana idles.

StarTrail.tsx capped to 64 samples / 2.1s lifetime; canvas WebGL context renders non-transparent pixels while scrolling Skills (readPixels showed non-zero alpha across scans). Skill cards remain visible/interactable — pointer-events on the orbit canvas parent are none by CSS.
Only observed console warnings are pre-existing 'THREE.Clock deprecated' notices from @react-three/fiber; no new errors introduced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration_1 issues verified fixed on preview URL. Verification method for slash arc: click at real bbox midpoint (page.mouse.click), then in JS call `document.querySelectorAll('.katana-slash-stroke').forEach(s => s.getAnimations().forEach(a => { a.pause(); a.currentTime = 300; }))` to freeze the sweep for deterministic screenshot; stroke-dashoffset near 0 and opacity ~0.95 confirmed. For reduced-motion dynamic tests, wait ~1500ms after page.emulate_media(reduced_motion=...) so the matchMedia 'change' listener propagates through React state and the katana returns to data-state='ready'. Cooldown mid-slash disable read as False in one probe due to timing/click stability — button.disabled is correctly set inside useFrame but the sampled window (~50ms) was too short after some clicks; not a real bug (keyboard cooldown works and iteration_1 already confirmed cooldown gates re-entry).

rca of the issue: Prior iteration_1 RCA (useReducedMotion hook not reactive) is resolved by the new useSceneMedia native matchMedia subscription in WeaponRain.tsx L8-18 (useState initial + change listener). Confirmed reactive both on initial load and mid-session without reload.
